svg.title: A normal isomorphism from the host tensor binary factor to the host
svg.desc: For a countable faithful finite-matrix product and a nonunit positive modular value lambda, almost-full paired block corners have normalized densities that differ by summable Hilbert–Schmidt errors from exact binary-state tensor residual densities. The nonzero infinite corner is normally isomorphic to R lambda tensor B. Type III corner comparison and binary interleaving give N tensor R lambda isomorphic N. The full type-I extension is proved separately through support corners.

g.text: Constructing N ⊗ Rλ ≅ N
0 < λ < 1; countable faithful finite-matrix product; λ belongs to S₊(N)
1. Pair almost all words in a block
Use the first block with a paired word.
Every pair has |r_z − λ| ≤ δₙ.
2. Keep pair mass; set its ratio to λ
Old pair: m_z (1, r_z) / (1 + r_z)
New pair: m_z (1, λ) / (1 + λ)
hₙ = 1 − Tr(√Dₙ √Qₙ) ≤ δₙ² / (2λ)
3. Two summable errors give two distinct conclusions
Σεₙ = 1/4
f = ∧ₙPₙ ≠ 0, with φ(f) = ∏ₙcₙ ≥ 3/4
Σδₙ² < ∞
Σhₙ < ∞ gives an onto unitary H_Q → H_D.
Regroup exact binary states: fNf ≅ Rλ ⊗ B, on the full normal algebras.
4. Compare the nonzero corner and interleave binary coordinates
Type III comparison gives α: N ≅ fNf ≅ Rλ ⊗ B.
N ⊗ Rλ ≅ Rλ ⊗ B ⊗ Rλ ≅ Rλ ⊗ Rλ ⊗ B ≅ Rλ ⊗ B ≅ N
The middle map places the two binary lists in the odd and even coordinates.
Proof: TP Sections 10–12. The general countable type-I product uses MIV29's support-corner reduction.
The converse uses the previously proved all-weight bound S₊(N)S₊(Rλ) ⊆ S₊(N ⊗ Rλ).
